title: Orthonormal basis adapted to a linear functional on ℝ^P
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, let β : ℝ^P → ℝ be a continuous linear functional (Euclid P →L[ℝ] ℝ) with operator norm ‖β‖, and let i₀ ∈ Fin P. Then there is an orthonormal basis f = (f_i)_{i ∈ Fin P} of ℝ^P (an OrthonormalBasis (Fin P) ℝ (Euclid P)) such that for every i ∈ Fin P, β(f_i) = ‖β‖ if i = i₀ and β(f_i) = 0 if i ≠ i₀.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (β : Euclid P →L[ℝ] ℝ) (i₀ : Fin P), ∃ f : OrthonormalBasis (Fin P) ℝ (Euclid P), ∀ i : Fin P, β (f i) = if i = i₀ then ‖β‖ else 0
